SELECT CAST(stat_row.stat_date AS SIGNED) AS stat_time, stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2, SUM(stat_row.send_total) AS send_total, SUM(stat_row.success_num) AS success_num, SUM(stat_row.delivered_num) AS delivered_num, SUM(stat_row.used_account_count) AS used_account_count, SUM(stat_row.banned_account_count) AS banned_account_count, SUM(stat_row.click_uv_num) AS click_uv_num, MAX(stat_row.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM hyperlink_stat_daily stat_row WHERE stat_row.stat_date BETWEEN #{statDateFrom} AND #{statDateTo}
GROUP BY stat_row.stat_date, stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2 ORDER BY stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2, stat_row.stat_date

SELECT stat_row.stat_hour_start_at AS stat_time, stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2, SUM(stat_row.send_total) AS send_total, SUM(stat_row.success_num) AS success_num, SUM(stat_row.delivered_num) AS delivered_num, SUM(stat_row.used_account_count) AS used_account_count, SUM(stat_row.banned_account_count) AS banned_account_count, SUM(stat_row.click_uv_num) AS click_uv_num, MAX(stat_row.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM hyperlink_stat_hourly stat_row WHERE stat_row.stat_hour_start_at>=#{startAt} AND stat_row.stat_hour_start_at<#{endExclusiveAt}
GROUP BY stat_row.stat_hour_start_at, stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2 ORDER BY stat_row.sender_country_iso2, stat_row.recipient_country_iso2, stat_row.stat_hour_start_at

SELECT COUNT(*) AS send_total, SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_num, SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_num, COUNT(DISTINCT recipient.account_id) AS used_account_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_row.usage_status=3 THEN recipient.account_id ELSE NULL END) AS banned_account_count, SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.first_visit_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_uv_num, MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(usage_row.updated_at,0)>recipient.updated_at THEN usage_row.updated_at ELSE recipient.updated_at END) AS updated_at FROM hyperlink_task_recipient recipient INNER JOIN hyperlink_task task ON task.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND task.id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id LEFT JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage usage_row ON usage_row.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND usage_row.hyperlink_task_id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id AND usage_row.account_id=recipient.account_id WHERE 1=1
SELECT DISTINCT recipient.tenant_id FROM hyperlink_task_recipient recipient WHERE recipient.submitted_at>=#{startAt} AND recipient.submitted_at<#{endAt} ORDER BY recipient.tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_stat_daily (tenant_id, stat_date, sender_country_iso2, recipient_country_iso2, account_type, task_type, sender_device_os, is_short_link_enabled, send_total, success_num, delivered_num, used_account_count, banned_account_count, click_uv_num, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{statDate}, COALESCE(recipient.sender_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.recipient_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.sender_account_type_snapshot,0), task.task_type, COALESCE(recipient.sender_device_os_snapshot,0), task.is_short_link_enabled, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(DISTINCT recipient.account_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_row.usage_status=3 THEN recipient.account_id ELSE NULL END), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.first_visit_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), #{now}, #{now} FROM hyperlink_task_recipient recipient INNER JOIN hyperlink_task task ON task.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND task.id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id LEFT JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage usage_row ON usage_row.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND usage_row.hyperlink_task_id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id AND usage_row.account_id=recipient.account_id WHERE recipient.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient.submitted_at>=#{startAt} AND recipient.submitted_at<#{endAt} GROUP BY COALESCE(recipient.sender_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.recipient_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.sender_account_type_snapshot,0), task.task_type, COALESCE(recipient.sender_device_os_snapshot,0), task.is_short_link_enabled ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE send_total=VALUES(send_total), success_num=VALUES(success_num), delivered_num=VALUES(delivered_num), used_account_count=VALUES(used_account_count), banned_account_count=VALUES(banned_account_count), click_uv_num=VALUES(click_uv_num), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO hyperlink_stat_hourly (tenant_id, stat_hour_start_at, sender_country_iso2, recipient_country_iso2, account_type, task_type, sender_device_os, is_short_link_enabled, send_total, success_num, delivered_num, used_account_count, banned_account_count, click_uv_num, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{hourStartAt}, COALESCE(recipient.sender_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.recipient_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.sender_account_type_snapshot,0), task.task_type, COALESCE(recipient.sender_device_os_snapshot,0), task.is_short_link_enabled, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(DISTINCT recipient.account_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_row.usage_status=3 THEN recipient.account_id ELSE NULL END), SUM(CASE WHEN recipient.first_visit_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), #{now}, #{now} FROM hyperlink_task_recipient recipient INNER JOIN hyperlink_task task ON task.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND task.id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id LEFT JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage usage_row ON usage_row.tenant_id=recipient.tenant_id AND usage_row.hyperlink_task_id=recipient.hyperlink_task_id AND usage_row.account_id=recipient.account_id WHERE recipient.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient.submitted_at>=#{hourStartAt} AND recipient.submitted_at<#{hourEndAt} GROUP BY COALESCE(recipient.sender_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.recipient_country_iso2_snapshot,'ZZ'), COALESCE(recipient.sender_account_type_snapshot,0), task.task_type, COALESCE(recipient.sender_device_os_snapshot,0), task.is_short_link_enabled ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE send_total=VALUES(send_total), success_num=VALUES(success_num), delivered_num=VALUES(delivered_num), used_account_count=VALUES(used_account_count), banned_account_count=VALUES(banned_account_count), click_uv_num=VALUES(click_uv_num), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hyperlink_stat_daily WHERE stat_date<#{statDate} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM hyperlink_stat_hourly WHERE stat_hour_start_at<#{hourStartAt} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
